Definition: from G5195; an insulter, i.e. maltreater:--despiteful, injurious.
BiblicalUsage: The word hybristḗs carries the sense of insolent, injurious, despiteful. In Romans 1:30, the text says "despiteful."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, hybristḗs means insolent, injurious, despiteful, nothing more and nothing less.
